info.title: Voxi Concierge API
info.description: Agent tools for the VOX 2.0 Digital Concierge. Write tools return an action reference; results arrive via get_action_result or SSE.

language.description: Film language, e.g. English, Hindi, Arabic, Malayalam

query.description: Free-text title, actor, keyword. Fuzzy matched.

rating.description: Classification such as G, PG, PG13, PG15, 15+, 18+

maxAge.description: Customer's child age; filters to suitable ratings

cinemaName.description: Cinema or mall name, fuzzy matched, e.g. 'Mall of the Emirates', 'MOE', 'Deira'

suggestAlternatives.description: If nothing matches, relax filters and return alternatives

bookingId.description: Vista booking id / reference, e.g. WL59LFJ

verification.description: Identity check for guests: last 4 digits of the phone on the booking, or the booking email. Not needed when the logged-in customer owns the booking.
Identity check for guests: last 4 digits of the phone on the booking, or the booking email. Not needed when the logged-in customer owns the booking.

tab.description: Combos | Popcorn | Drinks | Snacks | Hot Food | Desserts | Kids | GOLD Menu

confirmationId.description: From prepare_cancellation; proves the summary was read to the customer

autoAllocate.description: If true, ignore `seats` and let the system pick best available adjacent seats

paymentToken.description: Token from the widget payment sheet (simulated Checkout). Never a PAN.

summary.description: Agent-written summary; the middleware appends structured context

post.summary: Search movies (now showing, coming soon, advance booking) by title, actor, genre, language, rating or child age. Returns posters and trailers for cards.
Get full details for one movie: synopsis, cast, runtime, rating, languages, trailer.
Find showtimes for a movie and/or cinema on a date with optional experience, time window and language filters. Suggests alternatives when nothing matches.
List VOX cinemas, optionally by emirate or experience.
Cinema details: address, opening hours, experiences, parking, in-mall directions, accessibility.
Three nearest cinemas to GPS coordinates. Ask the widget for location first (request_location client tool).
Age restriction rules by rating and experience (e.g. GOLD/THEATRE 18+ policies) and whether a child of a given age may attend.
Available promotions and offers (bank, promo codes, Share Points, VOX Rewards) with images, eligibility and remaining balance.
Check if an offer applies to a session, member or card.
Explain how to book and return deep links to the booking page for a movie/session.
Find existing bookings by booking reference, email, phone or member id. Returns booking summary, tickets, seats, refund eligibility.
Evaluate the cancellation & refund policy for a booking (cut-off, used tickets, F&B, offers) and compute refund amount per method.
Create the cancellation summary the customer must confirm (refund amount, method). Returns confirmationId. ALWAYS read the summary to the customer before cancel_booking.
Prepare a swap to a different showtime: availability, price difference, refund/charge summary. Returns confirmationId.
Fetch the outcome of a previously requested action (cancellation, refund, swap, order step, payment, transfer). Waits briefly for completion.
Food & beverage menu per cinema/experience with prices, combos, images and dietary filters (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free).
Ticket types and prices for a session (adult, child, student, premium view...).
Seat map and availability for a session; renders the interactive seat map in the widget.
Current order (cart) summary: tickets, seats, F&B, offers, totals, expiry.
Create the payment summary the customer must confirm and open the payment sheet in the widget. Returns confirmationId.
Share Points and VOX Rewards balance for the logged-in member.
Whether the customer is logged in, their name, preferred language, location permission and any active order.
Simulated login by email/phone/member id and PIN (demo).
Bookings for the logged-in customer.
Personalised movie and F&B recommendations from profile preferences and purchase history.
Cancel a booking and trigger the refund exactly as summarised in prepare_cancellation. Requires confirmationId and confirmed=true.
Execute the prepared swap (refund original, rebook new session). Requires confirmationId and confirmed=true.
Start a new booking order for a session. Returns userSessionId.
Add tickets to the order.
Choose specific seats (or auto-allocate) for the tickets in the order.
Add food & beverage items to the order.
Apply an offer or promo code to the order.
Redeem Share Points or VOX Rewards against the order.
Complete payment and create the booking (QR + reference). Requires confirmationId and confirmed=true.
Abandon the in-progress order and release seats.
Record the end-of-chat feedback rating.
Log a customer complaint with the details gathered in conversation.
Hand the conversation to a human agent with a summary. Use on explicit request, frustration, or after two failed answers.
Mark a journey (e.g. 'movie_info', 'cancellation') completed or abandoned for reporting.
